lr.name: Amarekhodi womhlaba
lr.notice: Amarekhodi womhlaba agcina lokho irejista elikushoyo ecaleni kwalokho okudwetshiwe nalokho okuhanjiwe emhlabeni. Ifoni noma iwashi libeka indawo ngamamitha ambalwa kuphela kakhulu: ukuhamba kuyisiskisi somda, akuyona ukuhlola. Umhlolisisi ogunyaziwe kuphela nerejista yomhlaba ibeka umda ngokuqinisekile. Amaphepha okugcwalisa ayizinhlaka ukuze uzihlole, hhayi ifomu lanoma yimuphi umnyango.
lr.err.change: Lolo shintsho alukwazanga ukwenziwa. Akukho okushintshiwe.
lr.err.walkfile: Leli fayela alisiyo ifayela lokuhamba noma ifayela le-GPX.
lr.err.walk.newer: Leli fayela lokuhamba lenziwe yinguqulo entsha yalolu hlelo lokwengeza.
lr.err.gpx.size: Leli fayela le-GPX likhulu kakhulu ukuze lifundeke.
lr.err.gpx.doctype: Leli fayela le-GPX linesimemezelo sohlobo lwedokhumenti, okungadingeki kufayela le-GPX. Alifundwanga.
lr.err.gpx.empty: Leli fayela le-GPX alinawo amaphoyinti okuhamba, indlela noma umkhondo.
lr.walk.help: Hamba emhlabeni ngefoni bese ucindezela inkinobho kwikhona ngalinye. Vula lo mdwebo kufoni, uvule lo hlelo lokwengeza lapho, bese ucindezela Qala ukuhamba. Iwashi, inkinobho yehedisethi noma ikhlikhi le-Bluetooth kungacindezela inkinobho esikhundleni sakho. Indlela eqoshwe yiwashi noma yinoma yiluphi olunye uhlelo iza njengefayela le-GPX.
lr.place.crs: Lo mdwebo unohlelo lwezikhala ({crs}), ngakho ukuhamba kubekwa lapho kwenzeka khona ngempela.
lr.place.local: Lo mdwebo awunalo uhlelo lwezikhala. Ukuhamba kubekwa ecaleni kwalokho okudwetshiwe, kubheke enyakatho futhi kusayizi weqiniso, hhayi lapho kwenzeka khona ngempela. Setha kuqala uhlelo lwezikhala lomdwebo ukuze ulubeke emephini.
lr.walk.tol: Amakhona avela endleleni eqoshiwe: indlela ingakwazi kangakanani ukuphambuka ohlangothini oluqondile (m)
lr.walk.area: Umkhawulo ucishe ube {area}, kungaba {sigma} ngaphezu noma ngaphansi.
lr.walk.placed.local: Amaphoyinti okuhlola angu-{n} engezwe ecaleni komdwebo, enyakatho iphezulu (akukho uhlelo lwezikhala).
lr.walk.parcel: Ipaseli "{name}" yenziwe kumakhona, kanye nerekhodi elimakwe njengeUhanjiwe.
lr.walk.source: Ukuhamba emhlabeni {date}; ukunemba kwedivayisi okubi kakhulu {acc}
lr.w.name: Ukuhamba emhlabeni
lr.w.sketch: Amakhona athathiwe kuze kube manje nendawo okuyo
lr.w.acc.poor: Kubi: phakathi kuka-{m} m cishe. Linda, noma hamba uke kude nezindonga nemithi.
lr.w.count.area: Amaphoyinti angu-{n}. Cishe {area} m², kungaba {sigma} m² ngaphezu noma ngaphansi
lr.w.title: Ukuhamba emhlabeni: amaphoyinti angu-{n}
lr.w.took: Iphoyinti {n} lithathiwe, phakathi kuka-{m} m cishe (izilinganiso ezingu-{k} ezilinganisiwe).
lr.w.took.unknown: Iphoyinti {n} lithathiwe. Idivayisi ayishongo ukunemba kwayo.
lr.w.refuse.poor: Akuthathiwe: indawo ilungile cishe kuka-{m} m kuphela, kanti umkhawulo wakho ngu-{max} m. Linda kancane bese ucindezela futhi.
lr.w.refuse.full: Lokhu kuhamba sekugcwele. Qedela kuqala bese uqala elinye.
lr.w.remote: Sebenzisa iwashi, ihedisethi noma ikhlikhi njengenkinobho
lr.w.remote.on: Ilungile. Iwashi likhombisa "Ukuhamba emhlabeni" njengento edlalwayo: dlala, misa noma okulandelayo kumaka ikhona, okwangaphambili kususe elokugcina. Page Down noma Enter yekhlikhi nayo iyamaka. Umsindo uyathula.
lr.w.remote.keys: Leli bhrawuza alinikezi izinkinobho zewashi. Ikhlikhi le-Bluetooth noma ikhibhodi kusasebenza: Page Down noma Enter iyamaka, Page Up isusa iphoyinti lokugcina.
lr.w.awake.no: Leli bhrawuza alikwazi ukugcina isikrini sivuliwe. Setha isikhathi sesikrini sefoni side ngokwengeziwe ngokuhamba.
lr.w.notice: Mela endaweni ngayinye yekhona amasekhondi angu-{s}, bese ucindezela. Ukucindezela kwenqatshwa uma idivayisi isho ukuthi ayilungile ngaphezu kuka-{max} m. Lesi siskisi somhlaba, hhayi ukuhlola: ifoni ngokuvamile ayisondeli ngaphansi kwamamitha ambalwa, kubi kakhulu ngaphansi kwemithi nasecaleni kwezakhiwo.
lr.w.err.unsupported: Leli bhrawuza alikwazi ukufunda indawo yedivayisi.
lr.w.err.denied: Indawo yenqatshiwe. Vumela ukutholwa kwendawo kule sayithi kumasethingi webhrawuza, bese uqala ukuhamba futhi.
lr.w.err.unavailable: Idivayisi ayikwazi ukuthola indawo yayo njengamanje. Phuma ngaphandle, kude nezakhiwo.
lr.w.err.timeout: Idivayisi ithatha isikhathi eside ukuthola indawo yayo. Qhubeka ulinde ngaphandle.
lr.w.err.insecure: Ibhrawuza linikeza indawo kuphela ikhasi elivulwe nge-https.
lr.rec.help: Irekhodi elilodwa ngepaseli ngalinye: okushiwo irejista, isivumelwano noma ipulani. Amagama ayidatha yomuntu siqu futhi ahlala kufayela lalo mdwebo; akukho okuthunyelwa noma kwaphi.
lr.rec.pick: Khetha ipaseli oluhlwini ukuze ubone noma ubhale irekhodi layo.
lr.rec.noparcels: Lo mdwebo awunawo amapaseli okwamanje. Dweba elilodwa ngethuluzi le-Parcel, yenze ekuhambeni noma uwalethe kulayeri ye-GIS ngezansi.
lr.csv.none: Akukho rekhodi elifundeke kulelo fayela (imigqa engu-{n} yenqatshiwe). Umugqa wokuqala kufanele uqambe amakholomu, elinye lawo kube yinombolo yesabelo noma yepaseli.
lr.csv.done: Amarekhodi angu-{n} afundiwe, angu-{attached} afanisiwe nepaseli ngegama, imigqa engu-{bad} yenqatshiwe.
lr.use.title: Umhlaba ngokuchazwa
lr.use.help: Wonke amapaseli abalwa ngokusetshenziswa komhlaba nangezoni okushiwo irekhodi lawo.
lr.gis.title: Amapaseli namarekhodi avela kulayeri ye-GIS
lr.gis.none: Vula ilayeri ye-polygon (GeoJSON, shapefile, KML, GeoPackage) ku-CivilCraft ukuze wenze kuyo amapaseli namarekhodi.
lr.gis.empty: Leli layeri alinayo i-polygon yokwenza ipaseli kuyo.
lr.gis.made: Amapaseli angu-{n} enziwe, ngamunye unerekhodi lawo.
lr.check.help: Iqhathanisa ngalinye ipaseli njengoba lidwetshiwe nendawo irekhodi elishoyo, bese ifuna amapaseli ahlanganyela umhlaba, amakhona acishe ahlangane nomugqa womakhelwane, imikhawulo ezigqumela yona nezinombolo ezisetshenziswe kabili. Iqhathanisa; ayisho ukuthi yiliphi inani elilungile. Imikhawulo ngeyakho.
lr.check.tolgap: Ikhona eseduze komugqa womakhelwane, kodwa kungawufiki kuwo, iyabikwa (m)
lr.check.summary: Amapaseli angu-{n}, angu-{compared} aqhathaniswe nerekhodi, angu-{outside} ngaphandle komkhawulo wakho, okutholakele okungu-{issues}.
lr.check.capped: Kuphela amapaseli okuqala angu-600 aqhathaniswe omunye nomunye.
lr.check.stale: Umdwebo noma amarekhodi sekushintshile kusukela lokhu kuhlolwa. Phinda uhlole.
lr.issue.near: {a} no {b} abahlangani ngokuphelele: amakhona angu-{n} ahlala kuze kube ngu-{m} m komugqa womunye, kodwa awafiki kuwo.
lr.issue.crossing: Umkhawulo: {a} uzigqumela wona, ngakho indawo yawo ayisho lutho.
lr.issue.noarea: Irekhodi: {a} alikhombisi ndawo, ngakho akukho okuqhathaniswayo.
lr.ch.help: Qala ngokwenza ushintsho njengesiphakamiso. Akukho okushintsha emdwebeni kuze ucindezele Faka, futhi Faka yisinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
lr.ch.equal: Hlukanisa ipaseli elilodwa libe izabelo ezilingene
lr.ch.areas: Sika izabelo zezindawo ezinikeziwe kupaseli elilodwa
lr.ch.az: Indlela yemigqa yokuhlukanisa (amadigri ngokuqondile kusuka enyakatho)
lr.ch.line.help: Amaphoyinti amabili umugqa omusha edlula kuwo, ngokuhlelwa komdwebo. Umugqa uqhutshwa kuze kufike emaphethelweni.
lr.ch.title: Isihloko sesiphakamiso
lr.ch.worked: Kwenziwe: izabelo ezingu-{n}. Zihlole ngezansi, bese ugcina isiphakamiso noma usifake.
lr.ch.unbalanced: Umhlaba awulingani: izabelo zihluke ezipaseleni ezivela kuzo ngo-{area}.
lr.ch.kept: "{title}" ilondolozwe nomdwebo. Gcwalisa amaphepha ayo ngaphansi kwamaDokhumenti.
lr.ch.applied: "{title}" ifakiwe: umdwebo manje ukhombisa izabelo ezintsha, ngalinye linerekhodi elichaza ukuthi livela kuphi. Hlehlisa kuyibuyisela.
lr.ch.err.pick.consolidate: Hlola amapaseli amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlangene.
lr.ch.err.pick.boundary: Hlola amapaseli amabili umugqa wawo ohlangene oyohamba.
lr.ch.err.pick.designate: Hlola amapaseli okushintsha ukusetshenziswa komhlaba noma izoni yawo.
lr.ch.err.along: Lo mugqa uhamba ecaleni lepaseli. Wuhambise ukuze ungabi ecaleni.
lr.ch.err.ring: Lelo paseli linamakhona amancane kakhulu ukuze lisikwe.
lr.ch.err.area: Lezo zindawo azilingani: kufanele zibe ngaphezu kwe-zero futhi zihlanganise zibe ngaphansi kwepaseli.
lr.ch.err.pieces: Lokho kusika kuzoshiya isabelo ezingxenyeni ezingaphezu kwe-Kunye. Khetha enye indlela noma sika ngomugqa.
lr.ch.err.count: Nikeza inani lezabelo elisuka ku-2 kuya ku-200.
lr.ch.err.overlap: Lawo mapaseli ahlanganyela umhlaba. Lungisa lokho kuqala (bona Ukudweba kuhlolwa ngerekhodi).
lr.ch.err.apart: Lawo mapaseli ahlangana ngohlangothi, ngakho awakwazi ukwenziwa abe elilodwa.
lr.ch.err.hole: Uma ehlanganisiwe, lawo mapaseli azovala isikhala. Hlanganisa ngolunye ulandelano noma uvale isikhala kuqala.
lr.ch.err.touch: Lawo mapaseli ahlangana ekhoneni kanye nangohlangothini, okungakwazi ukuhlanganiswa okwamanje.
lr.ch.err.empty: Thayipha ukusetshenziswa okusha komhlaba noma izoni entsha.
lr.rule.title: Imithetho yezabelo zakho
lr.rule.help: Imikhawulo ofunde ukuthi isebenza emithethweni, uthayipha wena: izabelo ezincane kunazo zonke nobude obufushane bomphetho womgwaqo, kokusetshenziswa komhlaba oyedwa noma zonke izabelo. Izabelo ezintsha ziyahlolwa ngazo. Ubude bomphetho bulinganiswa emgqeni womgwaqo okhonjiwe kwizoni yepaseli; uma ungekho, aluhlolwa.
lr.rule.err: Thayipha indawo yesabelo esincane kunazo zonke noma umphetho omfushane kunawo wonke.
lr.rule.pass: Zonke izabelo ezintsha ziyahambisana nemithetho yakho yezabelo.
lr.doc.help: Igcwalisa iphepha lisuka esiphakamisweni: amapaseli angaphambi nangemva kwalo, izindawo, isizathu, nemininingwane othayipha kanye kuphela. Inani ngalinye elingakashiwo liphrintwa njengo "[akushiwo: …]" futhi libhalwe lapha; akukho okwenziwa.
lr.doc.err.pack: Leli fayela alisiyo iphakheji yamatemplate ahlelo lokwengeza olungayifunda.
lr.doc.pick: Gcina isiphakamiso ngaphansi kwoShintsha amapaseli kuqala, bese usikhetha oluhlwini lapho.
lr.doc.complete: Konke iphepha elikucela kona sekushiwo. Lifunde konke ngaphambi kokulithumela.
lr.doc.print: Vula ikhasi elilondoloziwe kubhrawuza uliphrinte, noma uligcine njenge-PDF efasiteleni lokuphrinta.
